correctness.rationale: All 37076, 27941 and 9135 augmented independent simplices enumerated exactly; exhaustive stagewise discrete-Morse matching has four 5-, three 5-, and one 4-dimensional unmatched cells respectively, plus an empty-to-vertex pair. Directed Hasse topological sorts verify acyclicity over 219240, 162087 and 48018 incidences. The nonempty Morse models are a point plus those higher cells, proving their integral wedge homotopy types. Left value relabelling acts transitively on vertices, and the inclusion S^4 to a 4-connected wedge of three S^5 is null, proving the vertex-cofibration splitting. A separate left-Cayley polynomial recurrence verifies three complete f-vectors and Euler characteristics.

value.rationale: The 24-vertex 3D permutahedron is canonical and the ordinary independence complex natural. The claim simultaneously identifies complete integral homotopy types for the global complex and both uniformly vertex-local deletion/link complexes, and proves a null attaching-map splitting. This is finer than an independence-polynomial/Euler count or generic suspension theorem; a high-dimensional simplicial complex reducing to four five-spheres has motivated topological content. Not an arbitrary parameter slice.
